title: Council to hold work session on Fire Rescue sixth-penny projects | Local News | wyomingnews.com
text:
CHEYENNE – The Cheyenne City Council will hold a work session at noon Friday to receive information on potential Cheyenne Fire Rescue projects for next year's sixth-penny sales tax ballot.
No votes will be taken during this work session.
CHEYENNE – The Cheyenne City Council will hold a work session at noon Friday to receive information on potential Cheyenne Fire Rescue projects for next year's sixth-penny sales tax ballot.
No votes will be taken during this work session.
An agenda for the meeting will be available at cheyennecity.org/minutesandagendas.
The session is available to attend in person in the Laramie County School District 1 Board Room at Storey Gym and will also be available to watch remotely. A Zoom link and information about watching remotely will be available at cheyennecity.org/zoom.
No public comment will be taken during the work session, and no other business will be conducted.
